description: Send a request for quotation to Cutlab on behalf of a customer in Estonia or anywhere in Europe. Not an order. Requires the customer's e-mail (contact_email), a description of at least 20 characters and customer_consent_to_contact = true. Files: public https links in file_links, or upload them after this call to the upload_url from the result (give the link to the customer: a browser page with drag and drop; or send each file with PUT {upload_url}/{filename} and the raw file as the body). Up to 10 files, 50 MB each: DXF, DWG, STEP/STP, PDF, AI, SVG, CDR, F3D, STL, 3MF, JPG/JPEG, PNG; the link is valid 7 days. POST {upload_url}/done after the last file (optional): notifies Cutlab at once; without it the notification is sent automatically about 2 minutes after the last file. Cutlab replies to the customer by e-mail, usually within 1–2 working days. Limit: 10 requests per day per IP.

country.description: Customer country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example DK; customers from any country can send a request

customer_consent_to_contact.description: The customer agrees to be contacted by e-mail about this request

file_links.description: Public https links to drawings or models. To send files without a public link, upload them to the upload_url returned in the response.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key that makes a retry safe: the same key never creates a second request

name: submit_rfq
title: Submit a request for quotation
